svg.title: One image result contains M predicted boxes
svg.desc: B counts images, M counts predictions for one image, and N counts its ground-truth boxes. predictions[0] is the first image result. boxes[j], labels[j], and scores[j] describe one prediction.
svg.metadata: Text outlines use Noto Sans CJK. Diagram authored for this article.

g.aria-label: One image result contains M predicted boxes
B = images in the batch M = predictions for one image N = ground-truth boxes
These three values describe one prediction. M does not need to equal N.
predictions[0]: first image result pred["boxes"][0]: first box for that image
